operations.description: Anodically bond glass via wafer to the bottom of the Si channel wafer (Figure S1(c) marks −1 kV). Pattern 1 µm SU-8 2 (Microchem) on the window membrane side: source gives 1 min bake cycles without bake temperatures, 93 mJ/cm² I-line exposure, 30 s development, IPA rinse and gentle drying. Bake at 70 °C for 1 min then 90 °C for 5 min; align using Karl Suss BA6. Press stack on a 120 °C hot plate and manually roll a cylindrical metal weight for ~5 min; hard-bake in a 150 °C oven for 1 h. These are wafer-bonding temperatures, not nanocrystal reaction temperatures.

operations.description: Center nanocrystal stream is ~7 µm in the 20 µm-wide, 1.5 mm mixing channel; product is probed at channel positions. XAS uses Se K edge 12.50–12.86 keV. The 4 ms capability at faster flow is apparatus capacity, not a second reported specimen. Device context: 110 nL chip, three 20 µm inlets, 20 µm × 1.5 mm mixing channel, then 43 µm-wide × 403 µm-deep × 5.5 mm observation channel under a 100 µm nitride window. At 36 µL/min the center speed is 52 µm/ms; the 16 × 7 µm beam crosses at 45° and Se fluorescence reaches a seven-element Ge detector at 90°. ALS Beamline 10.3.2 supplies Se K-edge micro-XAS. The 4 ms resolution at 104 µm/ms is a device capacity, not this specimen's measured outcome.

quality.review_scope: Main original PDF pp.1–6 and matched SI pp.1–4: typical chip XAS, distinct chip XRD sample, stopped-flow Figures 4–5, all five DDA Figure 6 curves and SI methanol Figure S3; source figures and route visuals. Independent scoped scientific quick audit accepted; selected recipe-and-figure review, not a complete-paper Reader.
missing_fields: Upstream TOPO-capped CdSe nanocrystal synthesis is cited but not stated in this paper.
No direct product size distribution, morphology image, isolated yield, or full EXAFS bond-distance/coordination result for the main chip-XAS product.
No exact product phase is established for each stopped-flow, DDA or methanol aliquot.

The main p.5 discussion describes exchange at room temperature; no numerical reaction temperature or branch-specific temperature control is reported. Most individual DDA-series 90%-conversion times are not reported.
No direct single-particle conversion time is measured; <8 ms single-particle timing is an author hypothesis.

Chip preparation: piranha formulation/amount, cleaning time, FDTS solution solvent/concentration/amount, silanization time/temperature and rinse/drying details are not specified in the reviewed main p.3 / SI p.3 passages; cited prior protocol not imported.
conflicts: Main Figure 4 stopped-flow caption says 6.67 mM AgClO4 before 1:1 mixing; Figure 5 says 6.66 mM. Both captions are retained; common 3.33 mM post-mix value is approximate.

Main p.4 body says both microfluidic XAS and stopped-flow observe exchange in 3.33 mM Ag+, whereas Figure 4 assigns the microfluidic trace 5 mM AgClO4 before side-stream mixing. Side-stream diffusion prevents a simple 1:1 chip dilution assignment; preserve both statements without merging conditions.
SI Figure S2 phase sample is 2.8 mM CdSe/5 mM AgClO4 chip reacted; main Figure 3 XAS uses 1.4/5 mM, so its tetragonal phase cannot be assigned to the same physical aliquot.
Figure 1d SEM depicts the silicon microchannel cross-section, not a nanocrystal morphology image.
